title: Safe tool calls
summary: The model calls tools with bad arguments and the app crashes. Validate everything and return clear errors.
hints: Wrap everything in one try/except so execute() never raises. Parse the arguments with json.loads and catch bad JSON.
Check against TOOLS: unknown tool, missing required field, unknown extra field, wrong type, pattern and enum. Put the field name in every error.
Numbers may arrive as text like "12.50". Convert them, but reject booleans and words. Check the refund amount against the order total last.
